strategy_roster.name: Vwap Cci
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP and CCI are unavailable; SMA(20) and RSI(20)<30 are explicit value/oversold proxies for the documented long condition. The cross back above the value proxy exits, and the documented 2% stop is retained; the short side is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: 3Commas Bot
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA 21/50 crossover is preserved exactly for the long side, with the opposite crossover as exit. ATR 14 stop, optional R:R target, and ATR trailing management have no percentage values in the source.

strategy_roster.name: New Intraday High With Weak Bar
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 10-bar highest test and 0.15 weak-bar ratio are retained using the prior-bar Donchian high and prior-bar high exit. The no-position condition is handled by the simulator; intraday time and short side are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: PVT Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: PVT is unavailable, so normalized volume-weighted price with two EMA(20) layers is an explicit crossover proxy; volume_ratio avoids raw-volume scale dependence. The documented EMA length is retained and the opposite cross exits; no stops are specified.

strategy_roster.name: Kloss
strategy_roster.entry_long: zscore(close,20) < 0 and roc(close,5) < 0 and close > ema(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: CCI and Stochastic are unavailable; negative z-score and five-bar ROC proxy their downside readings, while EMA(20) stands in for shifted WMA. Opposite oscillator/trend conditions exit; point-based stop/target and shift control are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Gold Dust
strategy_roster.notes: The perceptron formula and LWMA are unavailable; the documented MaPeriod 20 is represented by EMA(20), with a downside cross as the negative-output long proxy and the upside cross as its exit. Pip stop/trailing, multiple perceptrons, and sizing are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Double Channel EA
strategy_roster.notes: The custom DoubleChannel indicator and arrow rules are unavailable; a break above the prior 14-bar high is the documented-period long breakout proxy, with a prior 14-bar low break as exit. Stacking, schedule, and point-based risk controls are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Neural Network ATR
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,5) > 0 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1 and atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20)
strategy_roster.notes: The neural score and feature normalization are unavailable; bullish momentum, normalized volume expansion, and ATR expansion are explicit proxies for the documented input features. No default percentage risk values are supplied; spread, learning, and risk-management controls are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Cross MA ATR Notification
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA 4/12 crossover is retained exactly, with the opposite crossover as exit. ATR 6 is a stop calculation input in the source, but the ATR stop is not a percentage field; notifications and risk sizing are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Rubberbands Safety Net
strategy_roster.notes: The original alternating minute-cycle, hedged orders, and cash-based safety net are stateful and unavailable; bullish/bearish candles are an explicit long-side price-action proxy. Cash thresholds, averaging, session controls, and manual switches cannot be expressed in this DSL.
